CsrfToken.description: The csrf_token of the Kitaru login answer. Kitaru checks it on every request.

SessionCookie.description: The dashboard session cookie of Kitaru. A deployment can change the name with EVALVE_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, and an empty name turns this way to sign in off.
SessionCookie.name: evalve_session

get.description:
Unauthenticated. Says whether the backend can reach its database, and which build is running.

A deployment reads `image` to confirm that the exact image it asked for is the one serving.

List Loops across the deployment, newest first.

The list reads the Loop store only. It makes no Kitaru call apart from the identity check, and
it does not move a Loop.
